examplePersian: به والدین توصیه می‌شود زمان صفحه‌نمایش کودکان بسیار خردسال را محدود کنند.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

persianMeaning: برجسته بودن؛ متمایز بودن؛ به چشم آمدن
englishDefinition: To be noticeably different or better than others.
example: Two figures stand out in the report: rural incomes and youth unemployment.
examplePersian: دو عدد در گزارش برجسته است: درآمد روستایی و بیکاری جوانان.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: Development that meets present needs without damaging future capacity.
example: Sustainable development requires long-term planning rather than quick gains.
examplePersian: توسعهٔ پایدار مستلزم برنامه‌ریزی بلندمدت است نه سودهای سریع.
sourceLicense: Original LinguaFa editorial content

englishDefinition: A flat piece of thin glass used to hold tiny specimens for study under a microscope.
example: The biologist prepared a slide with cells from the tissue sample.
examplePersian: زیست‌شناس لامی با سلول‌های نمونه‌ی بافتی آماده کرد.

persianMeaning: مجاز، تنبیه و پیامد منفی که از سوی نهاد رسمی اعمال می‌شود
englishDefinition: A penalty imposed on someone, especially by a government or an official body.
example: Trading licences carry heavy sanctions if their rules are broken.
examplePersian: شکستن مقررات پروانه تجارت مجازات سنگینی به دنبال دارد.

englishDefinition: Relating to the way a system or economy is built and organised.
example: The report identifies structural causes behind the decline in rural incomes.
examplePersian: این گزارش علل ساختاری کاهش درآمد روستایی را شناسایی می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The full range of colours, qualities or ideas that something can include.
example: Public opinion covers a wide spectrum on the question of immigration.
examplePersian: دیدگاه عمومی درباره‌ی مهاجرت طیف گسترده‌ای دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A public event or piece of news that makes people shocked and angry because it is shameful.
example: The scandal led to the resignation of two senior officers.
examplePersian: این رسوایی به استعفای دو مقام ارشد انجامید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Not very obvious or noticeable, but present and important all the same.
example: There is a subtle difference in the colour of the two fabrics.
examplePersian: در رنگ دو پارچه تفاوت ظریفی وجود دارد که به‌راحتی دیده نمی‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The whole length of time or of distance that something covers.
example: Over a span of ten years, the forest lost half of its trees.
examplePersian: در بازه‌ی ده ساله، جنگل نیمی از درختانش را از دست داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Extremely cruel and violent, without any feeling for the people who are hurt.
example: The savage attack on the market left three shopkeepers injured.
examplePersian: حمله خشونت‌آمیز به بازار سه مغازه‌دار را مصدوم کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Using advanced and complex methods, showing high levels of skill and refinement.
example: The laboratory uses sophisticated equipment to detect trace pollutants.
examplePersian: آزمایشگاه از تجهیزات پیشرفته برای تشخیص آلاینده‌های ناچیز استفاده می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The general feeling and attitude that people hold towards a particular policy, event or idea.
example: Public sentiment has turned against the proposal for a new toll road.
examplePersian: گرایش افکار عمومی به سمت مخالفت با پیشنهاد جاده‌ی جدید با عوارض برگشته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A number of people or things that follow one another in a particular order.
example: The succession of drought years changed the whole farming economy.
examplePersian: توالی سال‌های خشک کل اقتصاد کشاورزی را دگرگون کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not connected with religion or religious belief, especially when talking about public life.
example: The speaker argued that secular education should be available to every child.
examplePersian: سخنران استدلال کرد که آموزش سکولار باید در دسترس همه‌ی کودکان باشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Having supreme power that is not limited by any higher authority.
example: Each sovereign state decides its own immigration rules.
examplePersian: هر کشور مستقل قوانین مهاجرتی خود را تعیین می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A detailed description of the exact materials, dimensions and standards needed for a product.
example: The architect provided detailed specifications for the new building's electrical system.
examplePersian: معمار مشخصات فنی دقیقی برای سیستم برق ساختمان تازه ارائه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The action of surrounding a fortified place with armed forces in order to capture it.
example: The castle withstood a three-month siege before it finally surrendered.
examplePersian: قلعه پس از یک محاصره‌ی سه‌ماهه سرانجام تسلیم شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A company that is completely owned and controlled by a larger parent company.
example: The parent company closed its subsidiary in the smaller market.
examplePersian: شرکت مادر، زیرمجموعه‌ی خود را در بازار کوچک‌تر تعطیل کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A particular area of activity, work or influence that somebody operates in.
example: The new law affects almost every sphere of public life.
examplePersian: قانون تازه تقریباً بر همه‌ی حوزه‌های زندگی عمومی اثر می‌گذارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: تکه باقیمانده، باقی و خرده‌های ماده
englishDefinition: A small piece of a thing that is left over after the rest has been used.
example: She wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
examplePersian: او نشانی را روی تکه‌ای کاغذ نوشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long narrow vertical passage or channel running through a building or the ground.
example: Fresh air is pumped down the ventilation shaft of the deep tunnel.
examplePersian: هوای تازه از طریق شافت تهویه‌ی تونل عمیق به پایین فرستاده می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The unity shared by a group of people who all support the same aim.
example: The workers showed solidarity by refusing to cross the picket line.
examplePersian: کارگران با امتناع از عبور از خط اعتصاب، همبستگی خود را نشان دادند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A continuous series of changes in which each one is larger, smaller or worse than the last.
example: The country fell into a downward spiral of debt and unemployment.
examplePersian: کشور در مارپیچ نزولی بدهی و بیکاری گرفتار شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A narrow piece of land that stretches out into the sea or into a lake.
example: The fishing village is built on a sandy spit at the mouth of the river.
examplePersian: روستای ماهیگیری روی نوک شنی دهان رودخانه ساخته شده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The cruel and indiscriminate killing of many people or of animals for food.
example: Historians still debate who was responsible for the slaughter of civilians.
examplePersian: مورخان هنوز درباره‌ی مسئولیت کشتار غیرنظامیان بحث می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The combining of separate parts or ideas into one new whole.
example: The essay is a synthesis of two quite different research traditions.
examplePersian: این مقاله ترکیبی از دو سنت پژوهشی کاملاً متفاوت است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A law that has been formally passed and approved by a legislative body.
example: Congress passed a new statute to regulate pollution across the country.
examplePersian: کنگره قانون تازه‌ای برای تنظیم آلودگی در سراسر کشور تصویب کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A fine-grained grey rock that splits into thin flat sheets and is used for roofing.
example: The roof of the old church was covered in grey slate.
examplePersian: بام کلیسای قدیمی با سنگ‌لوح خاکستری پوشانده شده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Something that encourages activity, interest or growth in a person or economy.
example: The news of the competition was a stimulus for the team to train harder.
examplePersian: خبر برگزاری مسابقه محرکی بود تا تیم سخت‌تر تمرین کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Based on personal feelings and opinions rather than on facts or evidence.
example: The essay is highly subjective because it quotes no evidence at all.
examplePersian: این مقاله بسیار ذهنی است زیرا هیچ شاهدی نقل نمی‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A small amount of a material taken from a body for testing in a laboratory.
example: Doctors took a blood specimen from the patient for testing.
examplePersian: پزشکان نمونه‌ی خون بیمار را برای آزمایش برداشتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Relating to the position of objects in space and to the distances between them.
example: The software helps young children to understand spatial relationships.
examplePersian: این نرم‌افزار به کودکان کمک می‌کند روابط فضایی را درک کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To officially order somebody to come and appear before a court.
example: The court issued a summons that required the witness to testify.
examplePersian: دادگاه احضاریه‌ای صادر کرد که شاهد را ملزم به شهادت می‌کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Using careful, detailed reasoning to study something.
example: The report uses an analytical approach to the problem.
examplePersian: گزارش رویکردی تحلیلی به مسئله دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0
